firascir.name: Firascir
firascir.description: The northern and western kingdom: islands, a long Atlantic coast and the cool inland country behind it, temperate, wooded and heavily farmed.

capital.description: The walled seat of the crown stands behind ditch and rampart. Every road in the country ends at its market cross.

walled_city.description: A walled city of tens of thousands, gates shut at dusk. A minster tower stands over the roofs and the market runs the length of the main street.

harbor_town.description: A harbour town stands around a sheltered bay. Fishing boats crowd its inner quay.

dock_town.description: A walled harbour town guards the coast road. Merchants unload beside its stone docks.

market_town.description: A market town stands among hedged fields and sheep pasture. Grain carts fill its square after harvest.

river_town.description: A river town stands where the old road meets the water. Reed beds line the bank below its bridge.

ford_village.description: A farming village stands beside a shallow crossing.

forest_village.description: A village of small farms stands where the ploughland gives out at the wood.

shore_village.description: A fishing village stands above a shingle beach, its boats drawn up past the tide line.

fen_village.description: A village of raised houses on the fen's one dry rise. Every door has a punt drawn up beside it, and the dykes are behind on their work.

field_village.description: A village of a dozen farms around a green, with ploughland running to the hedges on every side and one road through it.

cot_hamlet.description: A handful of cottages at a crossing of tracks, too few to have a market or a hall. The well is where the news is told.

mortellaria.name: Mortellaria
mortellaria.description: The southern kingdom around the middle sea: dry hills, olive terraces, old stone roads, and every coast it can reach by water.

capital.description: The walled seat of the crown stands above the road. White stone halls and tiled roofs surround its market.

walled_city.description: A city of tens of thousands inside old walls, its quarters stacked up the slope above a market that never empties before dark.

harbor_town.description: A harbour town fills a deep cove. Stone quays shelter fishing boats and merchant ships.

market_town.description: A market town stands among olive terraces. A public fountain fills the square below its presses.

hill_town.description: A stone town climbs a steep hill. Its upper gate overlooks the road below.

vineyard_village.description: A small village stands among vineyards and olive terraces. Wine carts wait beside its press house.

river_village.description: A farming village stands beside an irrigation channel. Reeds grow along its low walls.

coast_village.description: A fishing village stands where the coast road descends to a sheltered cove.

cot_hamlet.description: A few stone houses on a terrace, too few to have a market or a hall. The well under the fig tree is where the news is told.

tergal.name: Tergal
tergal.description: The eastern realm of the open grass: herd roads, river crossings and dry basins, held by clans under one high chief.

capital.description: The walled seat of the high chief stands on a low rise above the grass. Broad roads run from its great hall to the horse market and the east gate.

walled_city.description: A city of tens of thousands grown out of a great camp, its earth wall ringing a market where the roads from four directions meet.

road_town.description: A road town guards the river crossing. Traders camp outside its wall.

ridge_town.description: A stone town stands below the ridge. Herd pens and wool stores fill its lower quarter.

well_town.description: A low-walled town stands beside a deep well on the open grass. Salt and livestock caravans meet in its yard.

herd_village.description: A herding village stands beside a well on the open grass. Corrals surround its low houses.

river_village.description: A fishing and ferry village stands in a willow bend of the river.

basin_village.description: A small village stands beside a deep well in a dry hollow. Salt grass and goat pens surround it.

wood_village.description: A village of log houses in a clearing the forest is taking back. Furs and sawn timber go south from here, and little else does.

cot_hamlet.description: A few felt-roofed houses around a well, too few to have a market or a hall. Whoever waters last carries the news on.
